ordered_diagnoses: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome

s1.syndrome_frame: abnormal vaginal bleeding in a middle-aged woman with a significant family history of cancer
salient_findings: germline mutation R1331X in the MSH6 gene
key_facts: 43-year-old woman
abnormal vaginal bleeding
family history of prostate cancer in father and paternal grandfather
dilation and curettage was performed
tumor stained negative for MSH6 protein
MSI testing was negative
germline mutation R1331X was detected in the MSH6 gene
no physical examination findings were explicitly mentioned
